intro: Each Cosmic Age moves through four seasons in order. Return here during play for a quick reference.

seasons.title: Spring
seasons.subtitle: Set the Age & Gather Resources
seasons.summary: Set Cosmic Age, roll Zodiac Signs, Harvest, Commune, then Card Lock until Winter.

seasons.title: Summer
seasons.subtitle: Trade, Build & Prepare
seasons.summary: Turn-based: Craft (activate, houses, refine) and Consort (trade, duel, gambit) in any order.

seasons.title: Autumn
seasons.subtitle: Conduct the Great Work
seasons.summary: Fixed order: Leave Stasis, Opposition, Temper, Fire the Stone. Agekeeper oversees the Forge.

seasons.title: Winter
seasons.subtitle: Final Actions & Reset
seasons.summary: Unlock cards, optional Offering and Wager, enforce limits, shuffle deck, pass the Key.
